Bluebird Bio jumped after positive early-stage results for a gene-modifying immunotherapy developed with Celgene. Advancing stocks outnumbered decliners on both the NYSE and Nasdaq.

Despite Cleveland’s late-season decline, defensive struggles and narrow playoff-opening win over Indiana, the author argues against doubting LeBron James and the Cavaliers before the NBA Finals. Cleveland fell from a 25-7 start to near-.500 play after January and ranked among the league’s worst defensive teams. Questions also surround team chemistry, Kyrie Irving, Kevin Love, coach Tyronn Lue and James’s heavy workload. However, James has reached six consecutive Finals, advanced every time he entered the playoffs as a No. 2 seed and previously carried weaker rosters deep into the postseason. With Cleveland healthy and James’s history of elevating teammates, the author expects the Cavaliers’ greatest challenge to come in June, likely against the Warriors.

Star Bulk Carriers, a dry bulk shipper heavily exposed to Capesize vessels, acquired 16 ships built between 2010 and 2017 by assuming $310 million in debt and issuing 10.5 million shares. A jury will decide whether Tomas Gajowniczek, 37, is not guilty by reason of insanity of attempting to murder and seriously harm his partner, Alicja Kalinowska, in Dublin in June 2016. The prosecution alleged he punched, suffocated and beat her with a hammer, arguing his words and actions showed intent to kill. It said he was acutely intoxicated from cannabis and experiencing drug-induced psychosis, which does not qualify as a mental disorder under the Criminal Law (Insanity) Act 2006. The defence argued he had a disease of the mind that prevented him from controlling his actions, citing paranoia, previous concerning behaviour and his arrest under the Mental Health Act four days before the assault. It disputed evidence of intoxication, noting witnesses and medical personnel did not report that he appeared under the influence. Justice Patrick McCarthy will complete his directions to the jury tomorrow.

Doctors are challenging a Cigna policy that may reduce reimbursements. Separately, Judge Reed O’Connor sided with Humana against a 2023 Biden-era rule that would have increased federal audits of private Medicare plans and recovered billions of dollars. Other featured health topics include vaccines, hospital infection reporting, prescription drug tariffs, and experimental therapies.

Santa Barbara Public Library offers free weekly Spelling Basics workshops from July through August. Tuesday daytime sessions welcome seventh-graders through adults; Wednesday evenings are adults only. Classes meet at 40 E. Anapamu St.; preregistration is encouraged.

Carbon-related spin defects were created in hBN through ^13C implantation and thermal annealing. Photoluminescence and photon-correlation measurements identified single emitters near 600 nm. A defect spin pair contains one electron strongly hyperfine-coupled to a ^13C nuclear spin, forming an addressable four-level, two-qubit subsystem; the second electron remains spectrally separated.

ODMR showed hyperfine-split electron resonances separated by about 290 MHz and a central resonance from the second electron. ODNMR identified nuclear transitions at 141 and 145 MHz, with nuclear Rabi oscillations near 0.8 MHz under a 1 W RF drive at 73.5 mT. Selective microwave and radiofrequency pulses enabled control of individual electron and nuclear transitions. CPMG dynamical decoupling extended electron coherence from a Hahn-echo value of 148 ± 8 ns to 38 ± 10 μs with 1,024 pulses, following \(T_{2,e}\propto N^{0.77\pm0.09}\).

Conditional gates were implemented through selective transition driving, while electron-spin local gates used calibrated dual-tone microwaves to avoid unequal Rabi frequencies and beating. Optical initialization, SWAP operations, and electron reinitialization prepared the joint state \(|\downarrow_e\uparrow_n\rangle\). Subsequent conditional nuclear and electron gates generated all four electron–nuclear Bell states. Quantum state tomography reconstructed their density matrices for comparison with ideal Bell states.

The lecture defines batch arguments (BARGs), or SNARGs for Batch NP, which let a prover use one proof to show that multiple NP instances \(x_1,\ldots,x_k\) all belong to a language. A BARG consists of generator, prover, and verifier algorithms using a common reference string. Succinctness requires the proof to be shorter than the combined witnesses, avoiding the trivial approach of sending every witness. Completeness accepts honest proofs, while soundness prevents efficient cheating provers from proving a false batch.

BARGs resemble aggregated signatures and batch interactive proofs and are building blocks for SNARGs for all of P. Unlike general NP SNARGs, they can remain succinct without conflicting with the Gentry–Wichs lower bound: a proof of size near one witness length can still be much smaller than the batch’s total witness length.

The proposed construction from learning with errors begins with a simplified Kilian protocol. The prover generates a PCP for each instance-witness pair, arranges the PCPs as rows of a matrix, and hashes each column. A verifier selects one PCP query, the prover opens the queried columns, and the verifier checks hash consistency and runs PCP verification on every row. Parallel repetition reduces PCP soundness error to roughly \(2^{-\lambda}\).

To make the protocol non-interactive, a correlation-intractable hash derives the PCP query from the prover’s first message. This technique requires an associated relation to be sparse. Ordinary compressing hashes do not clearly provide sparsity because a fixed set of hash values may have many PCP-matrix preimages, each supporting different accepting queries.

The construction therefore uses a somewhere statistically binding (SSB) hash. Its key is computationally indistinguishable across selected indices, while the hash statistically binds the input at one chosen position. An SSB hash can be built from fully homomorphic encryption by encrypting an index and homomorphically selecting the corresponding input value. An extraction trapdoor can recover that bound value.

For soundness, if a batch is false, some fixed instance \(x_{i^*}\) is outside the language. By key indistinguishability, the proof switches to an SSB key binding row \(i^*\) of the PCP matrix. Extraction then fixes the PCP for that false instance. Any accepted proof yields a query that makes this extracted PCP pass verification, placing the hash-query pair in a sparse relation and contradicting correlation intractability.

The speaker accepts the presidency with gratitude and humility, invokes divine guidance, and pledges to preserve, protect, and defend the Constitution. He advocates strict adherence to the federal government’s delegated and limited powers, respect for state sovereignty, constitutional majority rule, minority rights, and judicious use of the executive veto.

He presents the federal Union as the source of national liberty, equality, peace, prosperity, and expansion, declaring that it must be preserved through constitutional compromises, opposition to sectional agitation, just laws, and avoidance of policies favoring particular classes or regions. He opposes national banks and similar institutions, supports economical government, prompt repayment of public debt, and state responsibility for state debts.

On taxation, he favors collecting only what an economical administration requires. He supports a tariff primarily for revenue, with moderate discrimination providing incidental and equitable protection to agriculture, manufacturing, commerce, navigation, and the mechanical arts, while distributing burdens fairly among citizens.

He supports annexing Texas as a peaceful agreement between independent powers that would promote security, commerce, development, and peace. He also pledges to maintain the United States’ claim to Oregon, protect settlers there, extend federal laws and institutions, and honor treaty obligations.

In foreign affairs, he promises respect for other nations’ rights, protection of American interests, avoidance of dangerous alliances, and expansion of trade. He demands accountability from public officers, especially those handling revenue, and states that the President must govern impartially for the whole people while implementing the principles supported by those who elected him.

AAPL is Apple Inc.’s Nasdaq ticker symbol. Apple, founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, develops consumer electronics, software, and online services, including the iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Its stock began trading on December 12, 1980.

Investors can purchase AAPL through brokers and hold shares indefinitely. Regular trading hours are 9:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m. ET, with trading also available before and after those hours. AAPL supports day trading, swing trading, scalping, and options, although the passage discourages scalping and notes that options trading is highly competitive.

Trading strategies should account for company fundamentals, technical characteristics, risk tolerance, entry and exit rules, and risk management. Backtesting, market knowledge, discipline, and awareness of relevant news and events are emphasized. No single indicator or time frame is considered universally best.

The passage reports a five-year average return of approximately 16.1%, an annual dividend of $0.82 per share, and an all-time high of $233.47 on October 3, 2018. Selling decisions may involve valuation, goals, diversification, fundamentals, market conditions, taxes, performance, and risk tolerance. Gains and dividends may be taxed. Becoming wealthy through AAPL trading is described as possible but difficult and unlikely.

The proposed Stay Rich Portfolio aims to preserve wealth after achieving financial independence. Historical data from 1926–2019 show that all asset classes, including Treasury bills, can suffer major drawdowns. US and foreign stocks offer stronger long-term return-to-drawdown ratios, while global diversification can modestly reduce drawdowns. The moderately conservative portfolio uses diversified, liquid ETFs, including stocks, TIPS, and corporate bonds, with approximately 75% US and 25% foreign exposure. TIPS address inflation risk, while corporate bonds may perform well during low inflation. The portfolio is evaluated through backtested returns, performance statistics, and drawdowns.

Former White House communications director Anthony Scaramucci said elements in Washington and the White House were undermining President Trump. Scaramucci, dismissed after 10 days following a recorded call with journalist Ryan Lizza, said he mistakenly believed the conversation was off the record.

Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels will start Sunday against the Chargers after missing two games with a sprained left knee. Fully cleared Wednesday, he will wear a brace but says it does not restrict his movement. Washington remains without two top receivers, while backup Marcus Mariota helped the offense score 61 points during Daniels’ absence.

The passage argues that revolutionary Marxist regimes generate mass refugee flows because their totalitarian demands disrupt established values and livelihoods. It cites the dispossession and displacement of Chinese residents in Vietnam, broader refugee totals from Marxist countries, and comparisons with non-Marxist autocracies. It contends that traditional autocracies are more capable of gradual liberalization and democratization than radical totalitarian governments, and that U.S. policy should encourage measured reforms when governments are not fighting violent insurgencies. The author maintains that Marxist-led armed revolutions are likely to produce totalitarian rule rather than democratic reform. Authentic democratic movements, the passage argues, seek government by consent, trust citizens to choose rulers, and do not postpone elections to reshape public beliefs. It concludes that revolutionary groups openly hostile to the United States should be treated as enemies, while rejecting accusations that the United States is racist, colonial, genocidal, expansionist, or a threat to peace.

Larry Connors and Cesar Alvarez’s Double Seven is a mean-reversion strategy introduced in *Short Term Trading Strategies That Work*. It buys when an ETF closes at a seven-day low while above its 200-day moving average and sells at a seven-day high, without a stop loss.

For SPY since 1993, the strategy generated 154 trades, averaging 1.18% with an 82.5% win rate, a 2.58 profit factor, 1.4 Sharpe ratio, and 33% maximum drawdown. Its 26% market exposure produced a 6.3% CAGR, versus 10.1% for buy-and-hold.

Across multiple ETFs, it produced 1,189 trades averaging 0.63%, but most gains occurred before 2010. A SPY-and-QQQ portfolio performed poorly because of overlapping trades. Testing entry periods from two to 15 days produced reasonable S&P 500 results, while reversing the strategy to short performed badly. The strategy still works on major stock indices, though the authors believe other mean-reversion strategies perform better.

NIH announced funding for 13 autism research teams, emphasizing environmental exposures during pregnancy alongside genetic factors. Researchers warn that measuring the “exposome” is difficult because people encounter many influences simultaneously. NIH also announced an $87 million initiative to develop organoids and other non-animal research methods. The FDA approved Evita Solutions’ low-cost generic mifepristone after a four-year application process, prompting opposition from anti-abortion groups and politicians. The Trump administration delayed for a year a policy addressing a Medicare drug-price negotiation loophole involving combined ingredients. Boston University professor Shoumita Dasgupta argued that administration rhetoric portraying autism as an epidemic dehumanizes autistic people and revives eugenic thinking.
A Dutch-speaking mechanical engineer is sought for a 12-month Genk mission starting within 1–4 weeks, requiring modelling, thermal and mechanical experience; chemical processing is advantageous.

The lecture reviews covariant and Lie derivatives, Killing vectors, and tensor densities. The Levi-Civita symbol has weight 1, while the metric determinant has weight −2, allowing tensor densities to be converted into tensors and used to construct covariant volume elements.

A determinant identity gives a shortcut for contracted Christoffel symbols, expressing them through derivatives of the metric determinant. This simplifies the covariant divergence of a vector and supports a curved-spacetime version of Gauss’s theorem. The simplification generally fails for tensors except in cases involving antisymmetry. Consequently, stress-energy conservation is local in general relativity and cannot generally be promoted unambiguously to global conservation because vectors at different points belong to different tangent spaces and transport is path-dependent.

The lecture then derives the geodesic equation for an idealized test body with mass but no charge, spin, or spatial extent. In a freely falling local Lorentz frame, such a body moves inertially, geometrically parallel-transporting its tangent vector. Expanding this condition yields the geodesic equation, which describes leading-order motion under gravity. Additional forces, spin, or finite size introduce corrections.

A geodesic can be parameterized affinely, meaning its tangent vector maintains constant normalization under transport; proper time is a natural affine parameter for timelike motion. Nonaffine parameterizations can be transformed into affine ones, while linear changes preserve affine parameterization.

A second derivation uses an action based on accumulated proper time. Requiring the action to be stationary gives the geodesic equation and shows that timelike geodesics extremize proper time, corresponding locally to maximal aging between events. Future topics include null geodesics for light and conserved quantities arising from Killing vectors.

Biogetica partnered with Research Needs to conduct evidence-based clinical trials and observational studies of multidisciplinary natural medicine. Planned 2018 research targets HPV, herpes, trigeminal neuralgia, vertigo, tinnitus, and cataract. The partnership will evaluate plant medicines from various cultures and validate Biogetica’s protocols combining nutraceuticals, herbs, and resonance homeopathies.

SpaceX targeted February 6, 2018, for Falcon Heavy’s launch from Kennedy Space Center, with February 7 as backup. The company planned to recover all three first stages. Despite a successful engine test, FAA approval, and the rocket’s substantial cargo capacity, CEO Elon Musk cautioned that it might not reach orbit and would consider avoiding launch-pad destruction a success. Further delays could cause indefinite postponement because federal funding expired February 8, preventing launches on government property during a shutdown.

The Tennessee Biorepository and Integrative Genomics (BIG) Initiative links genomic data, electronic health records, and environmental information from a diverse, predominantly pediatric Mid-South cohort. More than 42,000 participants have consented, and 13,152 genomes were analyzed; 87% of participants were under 18. Approximately 50% had inferred non-European or admixed ancestry, including 20% African and 30% admixed ancestry.

Ancestry showed geographic stratification, with European ancestry more prevalent in suburban areas and African ancestry more prevalent in urban areas, making geography a potential confounder. Asthma and obesity had higher odds ratios among minority groups, while zip-code patterns suggested environmental contributions.

Researchers identified 6.8 million high-confidence variable sites, including 771,717 novel variants. Novel variants were largely rare and ancestry-specific and were more frequently annotated as high impact than known variants. Genetic burden also varied among ancestry groups, although the authors caution that these findings require further investigation.

Self-reported race did not consistently align with inferred genetic ancestry; some genetically related individuals reported different races. The study therefore highlights limitations in using race as a biomedical variable. BIG combines community engagement and genomics education with inclusive research. Planned priorities include expanding adult enrollment, sustaining community education, and adopting pangenomic analysis to improve representation and precision medicine.

The study introduces a meta-learning approach using a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) to approximate the inverse Hessian in 4D-Var data assimilation. Rather than replacing classical optimization, the FNO predicts an initial state for the conjugate gradient (CG) solver, forming an FNO-CG method intended to improve convergence in high-dimensional, ill-conditioned problems.

The method was evaluated on a linear advection equation with varied background states, covariance length scales, and spatial and temporal observation configurations. Training and testing each used 5,400 samples. Sparse observations were incorporated implicitly through the adjoint-computed input to the FNO, avoiding a separate observation term in training.

As a standalone solver, the FNO was generally less accurate than CG, with an average relative error of \(1.86\times10^{-1}\), compared with \(4.26\times10^{-2}\) for CG. However, its predictions captured the overall initial-state structure and provided useful CG initialization. FNO-CG achieved an average relative error of \(1.61\times10^{-2}\) and required 105 iterations, compared with 127 for standard CG. This corresponds to a 62% reduction in average relative error and a 17% reduction in iteration count. Improvements were strongest for poorly conditioned problems. Future work will extend the approach to nonlinear PDEs and chaotic systems such as the Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equation.

A commodity trading advisor (CTA) provides or manages investments involving futures, commodity options, forex contracts, swaps, and other derivatives. CTAs may manage individual accounts or funds using managed-futures strategies and are generally compensated through management and performance fees. Advisors must register with the CFTC and join the NFA.

CTAs use discretionary or systematic strategies, though trend following is predominant. Systematic CTAs follow algorithm-generated signals based on technical or fundamental factors, reducing emotional intervention. Trend-following strategies identify medium- to long-term trends and determine both trading signals and exposure size. Momentum approaches may rank assets by past performance, buying winners and shorting losers across equities, bonds, currencies, and commodities.

Unlike broader hedge funds, CTAs are generally limited to futures, options, and currency swaps. Their central portfolio objective is combining multiple strategies and asset classes with low correlations. This can reduce volatility and improve risk-adjusted returns, even when individual strategies have modest performance.

A simple example holds the S&P 500 above its 200-day moving average and exits below it. The backtest produced a 6.73% CAGR and 28% maximum drawdown, compared with 7.16% for buy-and-hold, excluding dividends.

CTA strategies offer automation, diversification, and potential risk reduction but remain exposed to losses, market volatility, unreliable data, capital requirements, and knowledge demands. Complexity does not necessarily improve results; simple, complementary strategies may be effective.

Andropov may favor an arms control agreement because it could constrain U.S. defense programs, ease pressure on the Soviet economy, and strengthen his political position against rivals associated with détente. The passage argues that the United States, now pursuing a defense buildup, has little to lose by exploring negotiations while remaining vigilant. Efforts should focus on INF talks, where deadlines provide leverage and urgency, while START can wait. A private channel is preferred because it suits Andropov’s secrecy, facilitates bureaucratic management, and reduces the risk of leaks or obstruction by U.S. officials ideologically opposed to arms control. Past arms control failures are attributed partly to an inadequate U.S. bargaining “stick,” so negotiations should accompany continued defense strengthening. Initial contact should be a brief, serious letter recognizing the danger of renewed confrontation, acknowledging fundamental disagreements, emphasizing shared interests in peace, and inviting Andropov to pursue genuine nuclear arms reductions through the same private channel.

Enron faced mounting scrutiny after reporting a $618 million third-quarter loss, replacing CFO Andrew Fastow amid an SEC inquiry into related partnerships, and losing substantial market value. S&P affirmed Enron’s ratings but revised its outlook to negative, while Fitch and Moody’s considered downgrades over confidence, capital access, liabilities and balance-sheet concerns. Most trading partners continued business as usual, though some monitored or limited exposure because Enron represented about a quarter of U.S. power and gas trading. Enron said it had multibillion-dollar credit lines and planned asset sales to reduce debt. CEO Kenneth Lay resigned from i2 Technologies’ board to focus on Enron. Enron shares closed slightly lower on October 25 after seven consecutive declining sessions.

Soccer coaches should create documented, shared contingency plans rather than improvise when problems occur. Plans should address communication failures, cancellations, venue changes, player absences, backup leadership, injuries, medical needs, eligibility, fees, behavioral issues, difficult field and weather conditions, missing officials or equipment, transportation, game disruptions, player pickup, and extended coaching absences. Coaches should use checklists, assign responsibilities, prepare assistants, players, and parents, maintain backups and essential documents, and establish succession plans. Because not every event can be anticipated or controlled, multiple people should be ready to respond.

Darren McGregor praised Hibs’ resilience after overcoming an early deficit and an intense Ibrox atmosphere to beat Rangers 3-2. Simon Murray equalised before Ryan Jack was sent off, with a James Tavernier own goal and Vykintas Slivka strike securing victory despite Tavernier’s late header. McGregor supported Jack’s dismissal and said Hibs still deserved credit for creating chances against Rangers. He also praised Murray’s work rate and form after the striker reached ten goals in seven competitive matches. Manager Neil Lennon’s celebration and refereeing controversies overshadowed Hibs’ performance.

Nova Scotia Community College faculty and support staff ratified six-year agreements with seven-per-cent wage increases. Employees may collect retirement service awards immediately at 2018 salary levels or upon retirement at their final salary.

This systematic review examines empirically documented applications and risks of large language models (LLMs) in education. Using a PRISMA-guided search of five databases covering 2015–2025, the authors identified 70 studies, predominantly published between 2023 and 2025. Studies were grouped into three application areas: operational effectiveness, personalized applications, and interactive learning tools.

Operational uses include feedback generation, data processing, domain-specific tasks, and teaching. LLMs can complete many academic tasks and provide efficient feedback, but often exhibit superficial understanding, inconsistent performance, hallucinations, outdated knowledge, cultural bias, privacy vulnerabilities, and human-like authority that may encourage over-trust. They struggle with subjective, creative, context-sensitive, and specialized visual tasks. AI-generated writing can also be difficult for educators and detection tools to distinguish from human work.

Personalized applications include grading, progress monitoring, content generation, predictions, and recommendations. Studies report demographic disparities based on race, socioeconomic status, disability, gender, language, and educational background. Models may reproduce stereotypes, dominant linguistic norms, Western cultural assumptions, and unequal academic or career recommendations. Transparency influences whether students perceive AI-supported decisions as fair.

Interactive learning tools may improve efficiency, assignment completion, grammatical accuracy, and performance in some targeted tasks. However, frequent risks include reduced critical and metacognitive engagement, over-reliance, weaker revision practices, diminished student agency, lower creativity and motivation, shallow memory encoding, and poorer development of independent problem-solving skills. One EEG study found progressively lower neural connectivity as external assistance increased, with the LLM-assisted group showing the least engagement. Students may also accept confident outputs without verification, a pattern described as “verification drift.”

The review organizes risks into technical, pedagogical, and societal domains. Technical risks include toxic content, misinformation, bias, hallucinations, privacy violations, limited robustness, and model opacity. Pedagogical risks include reduced cognitive effort, memory erosion, weakened critical thinking, compromised academic integrity, and loss of autonomy. Societal risks include unequal access and skills, data colonialism, environmental harm, and regulatory gaps. These risks frequently overlap and compound one another.

The proposed LLM-Risk Adapted Learning Model describes three recurring stages: Interaction, Monitoring, and Outcome. Risks arising during initial interaction can weaken evaluation and memory during monitoring, producing outcomes such as over-reliance, reduced creativity, and limited motivation that then shape subsequent interactions.

Recommended mitigations include educator oversight, AI-literacy training, revised assessments emphasizing higher-order thinking, privacy safeguards, transparent usage policies, verification of outputs, diverse training data, continuous bias audits, explainability, human-in-the-loop governance, learner-centred design, and government regulation. The review calls for longitudinal, cross-cultural, and design-oriented research, noting limitations from its English-language focus, rapidly changing technology, and reliance on short-term studies.

VentureWire’s September 14, 2000 issue reports major technology investments, acquisitions, launches, and executive appointments. Inktomi agreed to acquire FastForward Networks for about $1.3 billion; Bertelsmann launched a $1 billion media and Internet venture fund; Algorithmics raised $60 million and acquired Sentry Financial Systems; Artisan Entertainment created a $50 million investment unit; and Privista raised $17 million. Numerous other companies secured financing, including Pax Clearing, Circadence, Epoch Internet, i2i, OnePage, and iMedica. Additional deals included 724 Solutions’ $53.4 million Spyonit acquisition and Covad’s $50 million purchase of a 70% stake in Loop Holdings Europe. Technologic Partners also named ten Investors’ Choice winners, including Google, Bluelight.com, and iSyndicate.

The passage specifies SD Memory Card host/card behavior for identification, transfer, read, write, erase, discard, Full User Area Logical Erase (FULE), protection, function switching, timing, and error handling.

During identification, the host remains at fOD; in Data Transfer Mode it may switch to fPP. CMD9 reads CSD, optional CMD4 configures driver stages, and CMD7 selects one card for Transfer State or deselects cards. Data communication is point-to-point with the selected card. CMD12 aborts reads and writes; writes must stop before deselection. Programming may continue after deselection, with DAT0 indicating busy. Resetting during programming terminates the operation and may destroy data. ACMD6 selects 1- or 4-bit bus width, but locked cards reject it.

Reads and writes are block-oriented and CRC-protected. Maximum normal block size is 512 bytes; a 2-GB card may report 1024-byte maximum block length but CMD16 remains limited to 512 bytes. CMD17 reads one block, while CMD18 reads continuously until CMD12. CMD24/CMD25 perform writes; erroneous CRC data is discarded. Misaligned, invalid-length, out-of-range, or write-protected accesses produce corresponding errors. Write buffering is optional, DAT0 signals inability to accept data, and CMD13 reports readiness. ACMD23 can pre-erase blocks before CMD25, and ACMD22 reports successfully written blocks.

Erase operations use CMD32, CMD33, then CMD38. Protected sectors remain intact. DISCARD uses CMD38 argument 00000001h, permits discarded contents to become “don’t care,” and is supported only by SDHC/SDXC outside SPI mode, with a 250-ms timeout. FULE uses argument 00000002h and requires the entire user area; it is also limited to SDHC/SDXC outside SPI and has a one-second timeout. Unsupported DISCARD or FULE requests execute ERASE.

Write protection includes a host-enforced mechanical switch, optional internal protection, and password locking. CMD42 manages passwords, locking, unlocking, clearing passwords, and force erase. Password registers are nonvolatile, and cards with a password set lock after power-up. Card Ownership Protection (COP) adds a Force Erase Password (FEP), COP Unlock, FEP management, and FEP-protected erase. When FEP is set, ordinary Force Erase and password clearing are disabled. FEP Force Erase requires the correct FEP, erases user data and PWD data, but retains FEP. Invalid CMD42 parameters or passwords set LOCK_UNLOCK_FAILED.

CMD55 marks the immediately following command as application-specific. Defined, legal ACMDs set APP_CMD status; undefined commands may be interpreted as regular commands, while illegal commands report errors. ACMD41 has special APP_CMD-status handling.

CMD6 checks or switches card functions, including access speed, command system, driver strength, and power limit. Mode 0 queries support, readiness, and maximum current or power; Mode 1 performs switching. Invalid selections cancel switching. Function 0 is default and 0xF preserves the current selection. Cards return a 512-bit status block containing supported functions, selected functions, busy status, and power information. Default power limit is 0.72 W; higher-performance UHS modes may require a higher setting. High-Speed mode provides a 25 MB/s interface using a 50-MHz clock and requires a one-to-one host/card connection.

CMD8, issued in Idle State before ACMD41, tests host supply voltage and returns an R7 response echoing the accepted voltage and check pattern. SDSC cards use byte addressing and CMD16-defined block lengths; SDHC/SDXC cards use 512-byte block addressing, disable partial and misaligned memory access, and do not support write-protected groups.

The host may reduce or stop the clock subject to restrictions, must provide eight clocks after transactions, and must supply a clock edge to release busy signaling. CRC7 protects commands, most responses, CID, and CSD; CRC16 protects data blocks, separately on each data line in wide-bus mode. CRC failures and illegal commands do not change card state and set status errors.

Read timeout is generally limited to 100 ms. Write timeout is generally limited to 250 ms, with specified SDXC cases allowing up to 500 ms. UHS-II Data Burst busy time may reach one second. The host should use fixed write timeouts rather than values calculated from R2W_FACTOR.

A TeamLease survey across nine Indian cities found job loss risk highest in Delhi, followed by Bengaluru and Hyderabad, and lowest in Pune. Industrial manufacturing had the highest sectoral risk, followed by construction and real estate, and BPO and IT-enabled services. Healthcare and telecom had the lowest risk.

Swedish players described a retiring compatriot as an icon, role model and exceptionally professional, low-key person. They praised his two-decade NHL career, four Stanley Cups, seven Norris Trophies, consistency, durability and excellence in both offense and defense. Henrik Tallinder called him Sweden’s best NHL player, while Johan Hedberg said his longevity and role as his franchise’s backbone set him apart, though comparisons with other European greats are difficult. Tallinder also said he felt physically ready to play after practicing for several weeks and would consider the opportunity a dream come true.

Naughty Dog highlighted Uncharted: The Lost Legacy at Sony’s E3 2017 conference. Featuring Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross, the adventure entered full-team development weeks after Uncharted 4 was completed.

Lord Williams’s School headteacher David Wybron is urging the Government to address pressures facing state schools. He argues that new GCSEs impose heavier, memory-based examinations on state pupils while independent schools can use IGCSEs with coursework, and calls for schools choosing IGCSEs not to face league-table penalties. He also highlights a teacher recruitment crisis, worsened by immigration controls, and supports adding teachers in all subjects to the shortage occupation list. Wybron says funding remains inadequate, with his pupils set to receive over £1,000 less per head than those in well-funded authorities, while staffing, inflation and infrastructure costs rise. He appeals for fairer examinations, honest recognition of recruitment problems, easier teacher visas and improved funding.

Low volatility investing focuses on stocks with relatively stable prices and beta below 1, often found in utilities, consumer staples, and healthcare. The strategy aims to reduce portfolio risk and produce consistent returns by selecting companies with stable earnings, reliable dividends, predictable business models, and lower debt.

Investors can implement it through low volatility ETFs or mutual funds, or by analyzing historical price data and selecting diversified stocks across sectors. Portfolios should be reviewed and rebalanced periodically, with a long investment horizon of years or decades. Backtesting can estimate historical performance but cannot reliably predict future results.

Research cited in the passage indicates that low volatility stocks have historically outperformed highly volatile stocks over long periods and delivered better risk-adjusted returns across developed and emerging markets. The most volatile stocks performed particularly poorly during market declines. Research on Berkshire Hathaway attributed its strong risk-adjusted performance largely to leverage and selecting cheap, safe, high-quality stocks.

Low volatility strategies can still experience extended underperformance, may provide lower returns over some periods, and may not suit every investor’s goals or risk tolerance. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

The Triple RSI trading strategy is a modified, mean-reversion RSI approach using four variables, including three RSI-based measures, the 200-day moving average, and buy/sell signals. Inspired by Larry Connors’ R3 strategy, it produced 83 SPY trades since 1993, averaging 1.4% per trade, with a 90–91% win rate and profit factor of 5. Its trade frequency is low but can potentially be increased by adjusting rules. The strategy may also complement a long-term buy-and-hold portfolio using cautious, limited leverage.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data-acquisition system with configurable 2- or 4-lane SDR/DDR source-synchronous output. Conversion results are transmitted MSB-first in 24-bit packets, with clocks generated from the sampling input. Data- and frame-clock frequencies depend on sampling rate, lane count, and SDR/DDR mode.

An optional XOR randomizer reduces input-correlated ground-bounce interference by XORing conversion data with either a PRBS bit or the result LSB. Simple averaging improves SNR while halving output rate; moving averaging preserves output rate. Configurable fixed, ramp, and alternating test patterns support interface debugging for channel groups 1–4 and 5–8.

Reset and power-down can be controlled through pins or registers. After power-up or reset, initialization requires register writes with a free-running sampling clock. Speed-boost mode samples one selected channel pair at up to 8MSPS while leaving the other six channels idle.

Configuration uses 16-bit registers in three banks addressed through 24-bit SPI frames. Bank 0 is always accessible; banks 1 and 2 require selection. SPI supports register reads, writes, and multi-device daisy chains, where operations require 24 clock cycles per ADC.

Registers configure data format, averaging, randomization, test patterns, gain correction, analog bandwidth and range, common-mode range, channel power-down, reference selection, lane count, and speed-boost operation. Reserved fields must remain at reset values.

For ATE applications, the integrated analog front end supports direct or multiplexed PMU connections. Post-calibration TUE is 0.0015% at 25°C ±5°C. Low-noise bandwidth reaches 22.7kHz, while 700kHz wide-bandwidth mode settles multiplexed signals to 99.95% full scale in 7.5µs.

The device uses AVDD_5V, VDD_1V8, and IOVDD supplies without a required power-up sequence. Recommended layout practices include close 0.1µF bypass capacitors, short ground and reference connections, avoiding vias between pins and capacitors, and separating digital lines from analog and reference paths.

Defensive tackles are interior defensive linemen who play a central role in stopping runs and pressuring quarterbacks. They penetrate the backfield, shed blocks, tackle ball carriers, disrupt passes, and absorb double teams to free linebackers, defensive backs, and edge rushers. Their contributions often do not appear in statistics but help defenses generate pressure without blitzing and defend runs with fewer players near the line.

Also called DTs, nose tackles, or nose guards when aligned over the center, defensive tackles typically have compact, sturdy builds around 6’2”–6’4” and 300–335 pounds. Key attributes include strength, agility, recognition, and toughness. Unlike offensive tackles, they line up inside rather than outside.

Notable defensive tackles include Aaron Donald, a Super Bowl champion and three-time NFL Defensive Player of the Year, and “Mean” Joe Greene, who helped Pittsburgh win four Super Bowls and earned two Defensive Player of the Year awards.

Intel shares rose 3%, bringing their monthly gain above 50% and raising the U.S. government’s stake to about $16 billion. The Trump administration acquired 433.3 million shares for $8.9 billion, or $20.47 per share, in August.

AMD’s March 2006 specification update documents numerous errata for the Geode CS5535 Companion Device silicon revision A3. Reported problems affect PIT and PIC behavior, DMA priority and access, thermal standby recovery, clock gating, debug functions, UART and LPC access during DMA, invalid I/O addresses, USB over-voltage tolerance, IDE/UDMA operations, ACPI register accesses, GPIO wake events, RTC RAM, SMBus, and sleep-state transitions. Many issues have minimal or no operational impact, while others may cause discarded transactions, invalid data, missed interrupts, hangs, register corruption, or failed wake and DMA operations.

Recommended mitigations include avoiding unsupported command sequences and features, disabling automatic clock gating in affected domains, using correctly sized register accesses, aligning IDE PRDs on DWORD boundaries, using single-transfer legacy DMA, issuing IDE commands before enabling bus mastering, and relying on specified software or hardware workarounds.

Issues 109–116 include premature LPC transaction aborts, incorrect SMB NEGACK behavior, a GLPCI retry counter that includes unrelated retries, GPIO high-bank atomic writes clearing other bits after suspend, insufficient SMBus data hold time, failure to set LOWBAT_FLAG after abnormal standby, and sleep-control signals remaining asserted when their delays exceed PM_SED. Workarounds include a PLD for LPC-to-ISA bridges, two writes when clearing NEGACK, increasing or disabling the retry limit, read-modify-write operations for GPIO registers, and programming sleep delays below PM_SED. No resolution is provided for the missing LOWBAT_FLAG.

China’s official manufacturing PMI rose to an eight-month high of 51.9 in May from 51.4 in April, exceeding forecasts and marking a 22nd month of expansion. Production, new orders and export orders strengthened, while high-tech manufacturing also accelerated. However, economists questioned whether the gains were sustainable, citing temporarily eased pollution controls, weaker infrastructure and property investment, deleveraging, rising borrowing costs and U.S.-China trade tensions.

Funding and cost pressures increased, particularly for small firms, whose activity contracted, while large and medium-sized companies expanded. Washington’s planned tariffs on up to $50 billion of Chinese imports renewed trade-war concerns.

China’s first-quarter economic growth was 6.8 percent, but investment and retail sales showed weakness. Economists forecast annual growth slowing to 6.5 percent from 6.9 percent in 2017. The services PMI edged up to 54.9, construction eased to 60.1, and the composite PMI rose to 54.6.

Density Functional Theory is accurate but computationally expensive, motivating machine-learning force fields for crystal property prediction. Existing graph-based representations—including pairwise, angular, and periodic vector models—often use finite local receptive fields and may map distinct crystals to identical representations, limiting their ability to capture long-range periodic interactions.

The work introduces PRDNet, a multimodal architecture combining real-space graph embeddings with reciprocal-space diffraction information. Its learned pseudo-particle probe produces environment-dependent synthetic diffraction patterns, aiming to distinguish atomic species and local environments more effectively than fixed X-ray, electron, or neutron form factors. The representation is designed to preserve complete structural information and remain invariant to crystal rotations, reflections, and translations.

Crystals are represented by atomic types, positions, and lattice vectors, while diffraction is formulated through the Fourier transform of electron density and structure factors. Evaluations on Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, and MatBench report state-of-the-art performance across crystal property prediction tasks.

NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere architecture improves programmable shading, ray tracing, and AI performance by up to 2× over Turing. Third-generation Tensor Cores enhance DLSS, enabling higher-performance ray-traced gaming and making 8K gaming at 60 fps feasible in supported titles. Second-generation RT Cores double ray/triangle intersection performance and accelerate ray-traced motion blur.

GA10x introduces GDDR6X memory, developed with Micron. Its PAM4 signaling transfers two bits per clock edge, supporting data rates up to 19.5 Gbps and peak bandwidth of 936 GB/sec. Maximum Transition Avoidance encoding, interface training, and equalization address signal-quality challenges. Error Detection and Replay detects and retries faulty memory transmissions, helping users identify overclocking limits through plateauing performance.

RTX IO works with Microsoft DirectStorage to move compressed data from NVMe storage to the GPU for lossless decompression. It can reduce CPU workload, accelerate I/O by up to 100× compared with hard drives and traditional APIs, improve loading and streaming, and benefit games and professional applications handling large datasets.

Ampere GPUs support DisplayPort 1.4a and HDMI 2.1, including 4K at 120 Hz and 8K at 60 Hz under specified compression or pixel-format requirements. Fifth-generation NVDEC supports hardware decoding for several codecs, including AV1 at up to 8K60 HDR with low CPU usage. Seventh-generation NVENC supports hardware encoding up to 4K H.264 and 8K HEVC.

The A40 targets data-center visual computing, offering 48 GB of memory, PCIe Gen4, virtualization support, and up to 96 GB through NVLink. The RTX A6000 provides 48 GB of GDDR6, expandable to 96 GB with NVLink, for professional rendering, simulation, AI, and large datasets. The RTX 3090 includes 24 GB of GDDR6X and targets creators, researchers, developers, and extreme gamers, while the RTX 3070 uses GDDR6 and is described as faster than the RTX 2080 Ti.

Lilly Nguyen and Phil De Carlos married at Texas Children’s Hospital on New Year’s Day to include their premature son, Lucas. Born at 24 weeks weighing 1 pound, 12 ounces, Lucas remained in the NICU, where De Carlos had proposed with nurses’ help. Lucas is growing and progressing.

MIT and the Carnegie Institution for Science publicly released 20 years of Keck Observatory data to support community searches for exoplanets. The collection contains nearly 61,000 measurements of more than 1,600 nearby stars, plus open-source software and a tutorial. Researchers have identified over 100 potential exoplanets, including one orbiting a star 8.1 light-years away. The dataset, compiled using the HIRES spectrometer, will be periodically updated and is available to academics and the public.

The Opportunity Project (TOP), a nonprofit serving about 600 children ages 1 to 5 in three high-poverty Wichita and Derby areas, provides early education alongside support for families. A study found TOP graduates outperformed comparable low-income students in academics, social skills and attendance through eighth grade. They were 19 percent more likely to read at grade level by third grade and 107 percent more likely by eighth grade.

TOP uses a child-directed educational approach in which teachers guide children through chosen activities. Scholarships combine grants, donations and public subsidies, while counselors connect families with food, clothing, health care, financial assistance, English instruction and educational opportunities. Parent Cafe workshops teach caregivers about child development, community resources and school advocacy.

Single father William Eckels enrolled his son Elijah after struggling to find affordable quality child care. Through TOP and its parent workshops, Eckels learned about early education, advocated for high-quality preschool with the Kansas governor and began considering a career as a preschool or elementary teacher.

The passage proposes Truthful Text Summarization (TTS), an incentive-aligned pipeline designed to prevent hallucinated, deceptive, or prompt-injected web content from influencing LLM summaries. TTS uses a leave-one-out process to derive atomic claims without the evaluated source, extracts each source’s support, contradiction, or abstention stance, and scores sources by beyond-chance agreement with peers. Low-scoring sources are filtered before final summarization.

The framework adapts multi-task peer prediction to open-web search, where visibility rather than payment provides incentives. Under stated assumptions, truthful reporting maximizes expected scores. The analysis establishes asymptotic informed truthfulness, strong truthfulness against significant deviations, and finite-sample guarantees that improve as the number of claims increases.

Experiments on 300-query subsets of Natural Questions and ClashEval used source pools containing reliable, deceptive, and adversarial documents. TTS outperformed standard synthesis and majority-based baselines. It achieved 70.7% answer accuracy on Natural Questions and 74.3% on ClashEval, compared with baseline ranges of 22.7–34.0% and 3.3–14.0%, respectively. It also separated reliable from unreliable sources without ground-truth labels and resisted coordinated uninformative behavior that defeated majority scoring. The authors conclude that TTS improves factuality and robustness while making truthful, informative reporting the most effective strategy for source inclusion.

In his farewell address, President Harry Truman welcomes the peaceful transfer of power to Dwight Eisenhower and urges Americans, regardless of party, to support the new president. He reflects on the presidency’s heavy decision-making responsibilities and recalls assuming office after Franklin Roosevelt’s death, Germany’s surrender, the Potsdam meeting, use of the atomic bomb against Japan, and the transition from war to peace.

Truman characterizes his presidency as dominated by the Cold War. He cites the creation of the United Nations, alliances, economic aid, the Berlin airlift, resistance to Soviet pressure in Iran, aid to Greece and Turkey, and intervention in Korea as measures that strengthened the free world and prevented wider war. He rejects initiating atomic war, arguing that peace, justice, and freedom cannot be secured through methods that violate those principles. He expresses confidence that free societies will ultimately prevail and envisions scientific resources, including atomic energy, being redirected from defense toward ending poverty and misery.

He also highlights domestic prosperity, employment, banking stability, broader income distribution, and progress toward equal civil, economic, and educational rights. Truman says he and Mrs. Truman leave without regret, believing they did their best for the nation and world peace. He thanks Americans for their support and emphasizes that presidential leadership depends on citizens’ participation.

The Trump administration began substantial permanent layoffs of federal workers on the 10th day of the government shutdown, targeting agencies including Treasury, Health and Human Services, Commerce, Education, Energy, EPA, Homeland Security, Housing and Urban Development, and Interior. President Trump said the cuts would affect “a lot” of workers and be “Democrat-oriented.” Unlike furloughs, reductions in force permanently eliminate jobs.

Federal employee unions vowed legal action, calling the layoffs illegal and harmful to essential public services. Democratic Senate leader Chuck Schumer accused the administration of deliberately creating chaos, while Republican Sen. Susan Collins also opposed the layoffs but blamed Schumer for the shutdown.

Republicans and Democrats remain deadlocked over temporary funding. Democrats demand an extension of enhanced Affordable Care Act tax credits, while repeated competing funding resolutions have failed in the Senate. The shutdown was expected to continue at least until the Senate returned Tuesday.

House Democrats Nancy Pelosi and Elijah Cummings mistakenly cited tweets from a fake Michael Flynn account while criticizing Republicans’ investigation of Flynn’s actions. Flynn’s son confirmed the account was fake. Both lawmakers later acknowledged the error. The New York Times also cited the unverified account before removing the references and correcting its story.

Seattle’s 103-year-old Smith Tower is modernizing its manually operated elevators to improve safety, reliability, accessibility and service while preserving their historic appearance. Owner Unico Properties said operators will no longer be required by mid-2018, though at least one will remain for historical significance. Longtime operator Hamilton Beale plans to return to Virginia after 18 years at the tower. Opened in 1914 with eight Otis elevators, the landmark now combines offices with a renovated observatory, bar and historical exhibits.

The passage defines legal, illegal, defined, and undefined SD commands and notes special handling of APP_CMD status around ACMD41, CMD11, and CMD3.

CMD6 switches or checks card functions in Transfer State. It supports six function groups with up to sixteen functions each, including access mode, command-system extensions, driver strength, and power limit. Mode 0 checks supported functions, busy status, and maximum current or power; Mode 1 switches functions. Function 0 is the default, while 0xF preserves the current selection. CMD6 returns R1 and a 512-bit status block. Hosts must verify card-version support, available power, and function readiness before switching. Power Limit defaults to 0.72 W and may be increased according to host supply, thermal, connector, and card requirements.

High-Speed mode provides a 25 MB/s interface at 50 MHz and is optionally selected through CMD6 on Version 1.10 or later cards. Command-system switching changes the interpretation of reserved commands CMD34–37, CMD50, and CMD57.

CMD8 initializes Version 2.00 or later cards by checking host voltage in Idle state and returning an R7 response containing the accepted voltage and echoed check pattern. ACMD41’s CCS bit distinguishes SDSC from SDHC or SDXC. SDSC uses byte addressing and CMD16-defined block lengths; SDHC and SDXC use fixed 512-byte blocks and block addressing, and disable partial or misaligned memory access.

Hosts may vary or stop the bus clock subject to transaction and ACMD41 restrictions, and generally must provide eight clocks after a transaction. Commands, responses, and data use CRC protection: CRC7 for commands and most responses, and CRC16 for data blocks. CRC or illegal-command errors leave card state unchanged and set corresponding status bits.

Read, write, and erase operations have defined timeout rules. SDHC and SDXC reads use at least 100 ms. Writes generally permit 250 ms busy periods, with specified SDXC cases allowing 500 ms; UHS-II data bursts may remain busy for up to one second.

Commands are fixed 48-bit codewords and are organized into command classes. Classes 0, 2, 4, 5, and 8 are mandatory; support for other classes depends on card type and features. UHS-II modifies or disallows some command behavior. Responses include R1, R1b, R2, R3, R6, and R7. Card Status, SD Status, and Task Status report command, feature, performance, and queued-task information.

Speed Class, UHS Speed Grade, and Video Speed Class describe recording performance. Allocation Units and Recording Units structure storage and performance measurement. Speed Classes 2, 4, 6, and 10 are defined; UHS grades indicate below 10 MB/s, at least 10 MB/s, or at least 30 MB/s. SDXC performance requires sequential writes to free Allocation Units and uses CMD20 to identify recording, directory, and continuous-information operations. CMD20 is mandatory for SDXC and optional for SDHC.

Diedrick Grafing deposited funds in savings banks under accounts titled in trust for Catharine Heilmann, retained the passbooks, and withdrew interest for his support until his death. He also transferred part of the principal to Heilmann and left instructions concerning disposition of the funds. His executrices claimed he intended to retain ownership during life and have Heilmann distribute the money after his death.

The court held that the deposits created a valid trust rather than a gift. Retention of the passbooks and receipt of interest were consistent with a trust, while payment of principal to Heilmann recognized her title and was not evidence of a loan. Even if she was to receive the funds only after Grafing’s death, the arrangement was not testamentary because her interest vested when the deposits were made. Any obligations Heilmann assumed to distribute funds to others were enforceable by those parties, not by the executrices. The judgment for Heilmann was affirmed with costs.

Vladimir Guerrero Jr., born in Montreal in 1999 and raised largely in the Dominican Republic, became a Toronto Blue Jays star and perennial All-Star candidate. His wife, Nathalie Guerrero, married him in 2023 after five years of dating. They have two daughters, Vlaimel and Vlaishel.

His father, Vladimir Guerrero Sr., played in MLB from 1996 to 2011, won the 2004 AL MVP and entered the Baseball Hall of Fame in 2018. Father and son share several baseball distinctions, including postseason grand slams, 40-home-run seasons, All-Star Game MVP honors and Home Run Derby titles. Guerrero Jr.’s mother, Riquelma Ramos, returned with him to the Dominican Republic during his childhood.

Baseball extends throughout the family. His brother Pablo is a Rangers prospect, while half-brother Vladi Miguel plays in the Mets organization. Uncle Wilton Guerrero played nine MLB seasons and helped teach Guerrero Jr. baseball from age five. Uncle Julio Guerrero played four minor-league seasons. Cousin Gabriel Guerrero briefly played for the Cincinnati Reds, and cousin Gregory Guerrero spent five years in the Mets’ minor-league system. Hall of Fame pitcher Pedro Martinez is Guerrero Jr.’s godfather.

Amazon.com’s unaudited Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2018 reported quarterly net sales of $52.9 billion, up 39% from $38.0 billion in 2017. Operating income rose to $3.0 billion from $628 million, while net income increased to $2.5 billion, or $5.07 per diluted share, from $197 million, or $0.40 per diluted share.

For the first six months of 2018, net sales were $103.9 billion, operating income was $4.9 billion, and net income was $4.2 billion. North America generated $62.9 billion in sales and $3.0 billion in operating income; International generated $29.5 billion in sales and a $1.1 billion operating loss; AWS generated $11.5 billion in sales and $3.0 billion in operating income. Growth reflected increased unit sales, third-party seller activity, Whole Foods Market, advertising, and higher AWS customer usage.

Operating cash flow was $5.7 billion for the first six months and $21.8 billion for the trailing twelve months. At June 30, 2018, Amazon had $19.8 billion in cash and cash equivalents, $7.2 billion in marketable securities, $134.1 billion in total assets, $50.8 billion in current liabilities, and $35.0 billion in stockholders’ equity. Long-term debt was $24.6 billion.

Amazon acquired Ring in April 2018 for approximately $853 million net of cash acquired. It adopted new revenue-recognition guidance, increasing retained earnings by approximately $650 million and reclassifying Prime membership and certain advertising revenue. The company expected new lease-accounting guidance, effective in 2019, to materially affect its balance sheets and disclosures.

Amazon reported $122.3 billion in contractual commitments and disclosed tax, sanctions, sales-tax, and patent-related contingencies. It stated that outcomes of legal proceedings could materially affect particular periods. Management expected existing cash, investments, operating cash flow, and borrowing arrangements to meet operating needs for at least the next 12 months.

OpenAI reached a $500 billion valuation after current and former employees sold about $6.6 billion in shares to investors including SoftBank, Thrive Capital, Dragoneer, MGX, and T. Rowe Price. Its valuation rose from roughly $300 billion earlier in 2025, supported by first-half revenue of $4.3 billion. The sale provides employee liquidity and strengthens OpenAI’s competitive position, while concerns remain about profitability, governance, regulation, market concentration, and sustaining investor enthusiasm.

The 123 reversal pattern is a three-swing formation signaling a potential trend change. A bearish pattern occurs when an uptrend produces a lower high and then breaks below the preceding low. A bullish pattern, or 123 bottom, occurs when a downtrend produces a higher low and then breaks above the preceding high.

The pattern is confirmed when price breaks point 2. Traders may enter at the breakout bar’s close or the next bar, or wait for a retest after a large breakout bar. Stop losses are generally placed beyond point 3, or beyond point 1 in volatile markets. Profit targets can be estimated by measuring the distance between point 2 and the midpoint of a line connecting points 1 and 3, then projecting it from the breakout. Partial profits and trailing stops are alternatives.

The pattern can be applied to stocks, forex, commodities, and Bitcoin, though the passage advises favoring bullish setups in stocks. Gold ETF GLD backtests were somewhat promising, with bullish reversals outperforming bearish reversals; a 20-day bullish exit produced a 2.22 profit factor. The strategy’s rules are partly subjective and may benefit from additional parameters.

Hajime, an IoT malware rival to Mirai, has reportedly infected about 100,000 devices worldwide. Like Mirai, it targets poorly secured cameras, DVRs, and routers using username-password combinations. Unlike Mirai, Hajime uses a decentralized peer-to-peer network based on BitTorrent protocols, making its botnet harder to disrupt.

Researchers have not identified Hajime’s creators or observed it launching DDoS attacks, leaving its purpose unknown. It could potentially support cybercrime, research, or efforts to hinder Mirai. Hajime appears more widespread but infects a narrower range of ARM-based devices, while Mirai variants target multiple architectures. The two malware compete for some devices, with Hajime limiting Mirai’s expansion.

Researchers recommend patching vulnerable IoT products, but many vendors have not issued updates, and some devices may be impossible to secure. Consequently, both malware networks are expected to persist and repeatedly reinfect devices.

NVIDIA’s Turing GPU architecture introduces enhanced video, connectivity, rendering, AI, and graphics-processing capabilities. Its NVENC encoder supports H.265 8K video at 30 fps, improves bitrate efficiency and encoding quality, and enables 4K streaming with low CPU use. NVDEC adds HEVC 4:4:4 and VP9 HDR decoding. VirtualLink combines display, data, and power for VR headsets through one USB-C connector.

TU102 and TU104 GPUs replace prior SLI interfaces with second-generation NVLink, providing up to 100 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth on TU102. They support two-way, but not three- or four-way, SLI.

Turing enables real-time ray tracing through dedicated RT Cores, NVIDIA RTX software, compatible APIs, BVH acceleration structures, and denoising. RT Cores autonomously perform BVH traversal and ray-triangle intersection tests, freeing shader processors for other work. Turing achieves over 10 Giga Rays per second and approximately ten times Pascal’s software ray-tracing performance. Hybrid rendering combines rasterization for efficient visibility processing with ray tracing for reflections, refractions, shadows, ambient occlusion, and indirect lighting.

NVIDIA NGX uses Turing Tensor Cores and pretrained neural networks for graphics features. Deep Learning Super-Sampling renders with fewer input samples and reconstructs target-resolution images, offering quality comparable to temporal anti-aliasing with reduced shading work. DLSS 2X targets image quality approaching 64-times supersampling. Other NGX functions include image inpainting, interpolated slow-motion video, and AI-based image or video upscaling.

Mesh Shading adds cooperative Task and Mesh Shader stages that reduce CPU draw-call bottlenecks, support dynamic level-of-detail selection, and enable real-time rendering of many complex objects. Variable Rate Shading independently controls shading rates for 16-by-16-pixel regions or individual primitives. Its uses include content-adaptive shading, motion-adaptive shading, and foveated rendering.

Texture Space Shading decouples visibility from appearance sampling, stores reusable shading results in texture space, and supports spatial and temporal reuse, variable detail, and more efficient stereo rendering. Multi-View Rendering processes geometry once for up to four hardware views per pass, supporting stereo VR, wide-field headsets, shadows, and multiple object instances.

The TU104 contains up to 3,072 CUDA Cores, 368 Tensor Cores, 48 RT Cores, and one x8 NVLink connection. Tesla T4 uses a TU104 configuration with 2,560 CUDA Cores and 320 Tensor Cores. TU106, used in GeForce RTX 2070, contains 2,304 CUDA Cores, 288 Tensor Cores, and 36 RT Cores, but lacks NVLink and SLI.

NVIDIA defines RTX-OPS as a workload-based hybrid-rendering metric combining weighted Tensor, FP32, RT, and INT32 throughput. The document concludes that hybrid rendering, denoising, BVH algorithms, and RT Cores collectively make real-time ray tracing practical on Turing GPUs.

The passage argues that gold’s rally alongside a weaker dollar did not alter its technical outlook, while silver and mining stocks showed little strength. Miners’ failure to outperform gold is presented as an early sign of a broader decline. The USD Index’s inverse head-and-shoulders breakout is described as bullish, with a potential target above 101.3. Stocks are also viewed as bearish after breaking support despite a short-term pause. The author compares these conditions—resilient gold, a strengthening dollar, falling stocks, and weak miners—to 2008. The passage also includes promotional material, reader comments, market headlines, and trading-risk disclosures.

The disclosure describes cooperative monitoring networks that temporarily combine independent security, automation, health, and surveillance systems to monitor and respond to events across homes, businesses, neighborhoods, or mobile-user locations. A monitoring application server, central alarm station, or distributed control units analyze an event against configurable rules and select nearby or otherwise relevant monitoring systems, subject to user preferences and consent. Participating sensors, cameras, lights, household devices, user devices, public cameras, and street lamps may share data, issue alerts, illuminate areas, and coordinate responses.

Networks may expand, contract, or disband according to event location, timing, severity, responder availability, and tracked movement. Examples include following an intruder across camera views, locating missing people or animals, responding to medical emergencies, assisting a mobile user who activates a panic button, and cascading notifications outward until someone responds. Image processing and machine-learning techniques may predict routes and support dynamic selection of monitoring systems.

The system can compare data across properties to distinguish isolated events from cooperative events. Shared failures may indicate neighborhood-wide power, telephone, or radio-frequency problems, while correlated solar-panel abnormalities may identify false alarms caused by environmental conditions. Users can define event criteria, participants, responses, and adaptation schemes through an interface. The techniques may be implemented in hardware, software, firmware, computer-readable storage media, or combinations thereof.

The UCLA High Post Rub Offense, associated with John Wooden’s championship teams, uses spacing, inside-outside play, a skilled high-post passer/shooter, and a point guard capable of posting up. Typically initiated from a 1–4 alignment, the point guard passes to a wing and cuts off a high-post screen for a layup or post-up. If unavailable, the offense proceeds into ball reversal and down-screen action.

Players respond to defensive coverage with specific counters, including inside cuts, bump-outs, screen slips, rolls, isolations, back screens, lobs, curls, fades, back cuts, and screen-and-rolls. Low-post options depend on defender positioning and include power layups, baby hooks, face-ups, lobs, and pressure releases against double teams. Defensive denial triggers automatic back cuts, high-post feeds, weakside entries, lobs, or diagonal screens.

Successful execution requires coordinated footwork, timing, screening, spacing, communication, and knowledge of defensive reads. Teaching should combine breakdown drills, small-group work, scrimmaging, and individual skill development. Coaches should scout opponents, monitor defensive adjustments, vary alignments and entries, and target weak defenders.

The new President acknowledges assuming office without election amid extraordinary national turmoil and asks for Americans’ prayers and support. Owing allegiance to no partisan platform, he pledges to serve all people, consult Congress on urgent national priorities, and promote unity and progress. He commits the United States to strength, freedom, and a sincere search for global peace while promising openness, candor, and honesty in government. Declaring the national nightmare over, he affirms that the Constitution and rule of law endure. He urges the country to heal the wounds of Watergate through justice, mercy, and brotherly love, asks for prayers for Richard Nixon and his family, and vows to uphold the Constitution, do what is right, and give his best to America.

The passage calls for expanded reservation-based education that teaches Indians English, self-support, diverse trades, and native industries according to individual aptitude, while holding government officials to strict ethical standards. It praises scientific agricultural assistance, including pest control, new crops suited to regional conditions, range restoration, and improved fruit storage and export. It urges Congress to support Smithsonian plans for a national museum preserving records and specimens of vanishing peoples and animals. Washington, D.C., should serve as a national model through strong sanitation, prevention of slums, advanced charitable and correctional systems, and exemplary labor protections. Recommended measures include employer-liability legislation, railroad safety requirements, and improvements to the 1893 safety-appliance law, which had prevented thousands of casualties.

A widely forwarded chain email claims that seven-year-old Amy Bruce has lung cancer and a brain tumor, and that the Make-A-Wish Foundation will donate seven cents for every name added. It urges recipients to forward the message and warns those who do not. Jennifer Cutaia forwarded it to three Enron employees on November 27, 2000.

Troll Cakes, a New York City bakery/detective agency, turns online insults into chocolate chip brownie cakes and anonymously sends them to trolls. Cakes cost $35, with address tracking available for an additional $25. A $30 option sends a chosen Trump tweet to the White House. The concept aims to counter trolling with kindness.

Travis Zajac described the opposing goalie as quick, active and strong on rebounds. His team needs more traffic and shots, while drawing confidence from past playoff comebacks and focusing on winning the next game.

The speaker hopes improved conditions and team depth will reduce the impact of Dallas’s heat. After a missed opportunity, the team must correct mistakes without overreacting. Dallas is strong in transition, so success depends on navigating the neutral zone, putting the puck deep, cycling, finishing checks, and winning individual battles. The team executed these details well in the first game but played into Dallas’s hands in the second, limiting its speed despite having chances to win. Maintaining simple, consistent play and doing the “dirty work” are emphasized. The team has performed well on the road by playing relaxed and doing whatever is necessary to win, which has been an advantage during the playoffs.

After entering late in the Stanley Cup Final, the speaker acknowledged a puck-handling mistake, possibly related to inactivity, but expressed confidence in helping the team by staying prepared and working hard.

This study examined associations between maternal and child gut microbiomes and early neurodevelopment using 116 mother-child pairs from the Vitamin D Antenatal Asthma Reduction Trial. Stool microbiota, metabolites, and short-chain fatty acids were measured during the maternal third trimester and in children at 3–6 months, one year, and three years. Neurodevelopment was assessed annually through age three using five domains of the Ages and Stages Questionnaire (ASQ).

Multinomial regression showed that the maternal gut microbiome and metabolites were most predictive of children’s neurodevelopment at age one. Their predictive power exceeded that of the infant microbiome and declined substantially for age-two outcomes. The infant microbiota was weakly associated with age-one ASQ scores, while infant metabolites showed limited relevance to age-two scores. The child microbiome at age one did not predict concurrent neurodevelopment and was only slightly predictive of age-two outcomes. Neither maternal nor child microbiomes predicted neurodevelopment at age three.

Although children’s microbiota became increasingly similar to their mothers’ with age, this similarity did not correspond to stronger neurodevelopmental prediction. Maternal and infant microbiota shared several ASQ-associated taxa, but some, including Fusobacteriia and Fusobacteriota, displayed differing or opposite associations across developmental domains.

The findings suggest that pregnancy may be a critical period for associations between the gut microbiome and early neurodevelopment. Limitations include the small sample size, limited pregnancy sampling, and very low Fusobacteriia abundance. Larger longitudinal studies, additional pregnancy time points, multi-omics analyses, and experimental validation are needed.

Observations show that 14 of 16 dwarf galaxies orbiting Centaurus A move in a common plane, contrary to the lambda cold dark matter model’s expectation that satellites form a roughly spherical cloud with random orbits. Similar alignments occur around the Milky Way and Andromeda, but this is the first detected outside the Local Group. Study author Marcel Pawlowski suggested the finding may expose missing elements or flaws in current dark matter theories. Other astrophysicists argue the alignment could be a statistical fluke or an effect of large-scale dark matter filaments not reflected in simulations. Researchers say observations of more distant galaxies are needed to determine whether shared-plane satellite orbits seriously challenge the standard model.

Andrew Lo recommends net present value (NPV), or adjusted present value (APV) for advanced analyses, as the primary capital-budgeting criterion. Positive-NPV projects should be accepted; among mutually exclusive projects, the project with the highest NPV should be chosen.

Alternative methods remain common but have limitations. Payback period measures how quickly an investment is recovered but ignores the time value of money, scale, and cash flows after recovery. Discounted payback corrects for timing but still omits later cash flows. Payback may nevertheless highlight estimation uncertainty, liquidity, and managerial career risk.

The profitability index divides the present value of future cash flows by the initial investment. It generally agrees with NPV on accepting independent projects but can rank mutually exclusive projects incorrectly because it ignores scale. Scale is especially important in corporate capital budgeting because additional investment may change project returns.

Internal rate of return (IRR) is the discount rate at which a project breaks even. It can match NPV when there is one initial outflow, subsequent nonnegative cash flows, one project, a constant opportunity cost of capital, and an equivalent hurdle rate. Otherwise, IRR may not exist, may have multiple real solutions, may reverse rankings for loans, and ignores scale. It is widely used for bonds and private equity, where its assumptions often approximately hold.

In practice, firms frequently use payback and IRR, though NPV has gained prominence. More advanced capital budgeting must address taxes, project interactions, changing risks, competitive responses, capital rationing, investment scale, and political, social, cultural, and implementation considerations. Cash-flow analysis should use after-tax cash flows rather than accounting earnings, with risk-adjusted discount rates such as those derived from CAPM.

The lecture then introduces market efficiency, the view that prices incorporate available information and offer no free arbitrage. As evidence, Morton Thiokol’s stock fell most sharply within hours of the 1986 Challenger explosion, months before an official investigation attributed the disaster to an O-ring it produced. Subsequent discussion will examine where market efficiency fails and how rational-market and behavioral perspectives may be reconciled.

Tesla Motors and Tesla Motors Netherlands entered a senior secured asset-based revolving credit agreement on June 10, 2015, with several banks. The facility provides up to $500 million, potentially expandable by $250 million, plus $100 million for letters of credit and $40 million for swingline loans. Proceeds may fund working capital and general corporate purposes. The facility matures June 10, 2020, and had no outstanding balance at closing.

Borrowing availability depends on eligible inventory, receivables, equipment and applicable reserves. Interest is charged at floating rates plus 1.0% for LIBOR loans or 0.0% for base-rate loans, with a 0.25% annual fee on unused commitments. Obligations are guaranteed and secured by specified assets. The agreement includes reporting requirements, restrictions on dividends, debt, liens and stock transactions, a potential minimum fixed-charge coverage ratio, and customary default provisions allowing acceleration and foreclosure.

Offensive corner kicks are planned restarts requiring a set play, designated target, and accurate service from a selected taker.
